Notes_and_Tips: Include eggs, chicken, fish or paneer regularly to support thyroid function and healthy hair growth.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Since you work indoors and currently don't exercise, start with a 30-minute walk at least 5 days per week.
Maintain regular meal timings despite your afternoon and evening work schedule.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily.
Continue practicing yoga if possible, or include regular physical activity to support overall health.
